name: cubrid-python-ecosystem-presentation
description: Slidev presentation for the 2026 OSS Developer Contest Finals

scripts.export:ossdevcon:pdf: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('exports', {recursive:true})" && slidev export 2026-ossdevcon.md --format pdf --with-clicks false --timeout 60000 --wait-until networkidle --wait 5000 --output exports/ossdevcon.pdf
scripts.export:ossdevcon:pptx: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('exports', {recursive:true})" && slidev export 2026-ossdevcon.md --format pptx --with-clicks false --timeout 60000 --wait-until networkidle --wait 5000 --output exports/ossdevcon.pptx
